newsitem.title: CHINA: China field to supply natgas to Beijing before '98.
newsitem.headline: China field to supply natgas to Beijing before '98.

text.p: China's largest onshore natural gas field would begin supplying gas to Beijing, Xi'an, Yinchuan and Yulin cities before 1998, the China News Service said on Monday.

The first phase development of the Shan'ganning natural gas field would produce 3.0 billion cubic metres of gas a year, with 1.65 billion cubic metres going to the four cities before 1998, the agency said.
The field in the northern provinces of Shaanxi and Inner Mongolia has estimated reserves of 230 billion cubic metres of gas and proven reserves of 70 million cubic metres, the agency said.
